sources.name: Arcade Club Game Library
sources.example_data_quote: Jubeat ... Available At BURY, LEEDS, BLACKPOOL. Pop'n Music Éclale Available At BURY only. MÚSECA Available At BURY, BLACKPOOL. Game pages use /games/{slug}/; A-Z index at /a-z/{letter}/. CC BY-SA 3.0 licensed library.
sources.adds_over_current: Official operator confirmation of which music cabs sit at which of the 3 sites (Bury/Leeds/Blackpool). Map already has very full ZIv lists for all three (Arcade Club Bury already classified chunithm, iidx, sdvx, popn, jubeat, etc.). Useful as ground-truth / refresh source for those 3 venues only; does not cover the ~428 other-only UK/IE stubs.
sources.note: Best structured UK cab/game database found. 500+ titles claimed. Per-game pages list venue availability. Only 3 venues total. Free-play chain, not a national multi-operator wiki like hkarcade.fandom.

sources.name: Pinball Map United Kingdom
sources.example_data_quote: Site reports ~228 locations & ~788 machines in UK map results. Live RSS (location_machine_xrefs.rss) e.g. 'Elvis (Stern, 2004) was added to Continue Arcades in Taunton'; 'Jurassic Park (Pro) was added to NQ64 Birmingham'. API at /api/v1/region/:region/locations.json requires api_token.
sources.adds_over_current: Pinball machine lists only, not rhythm/music games. Can discover bar/arcade venues and pinball lineups the map does not track as music games. Example: Continue Arcades Taunton is other-only with empty notes in arcades.json; Pinball Map has recent pinball additions there but still no DDR/bemani. Overlap with many ZIv venues (Arcade Club, NQ64, Four Quarters, Playback) without adding classified music games.
sources.note: Actively maintained community map with API + RSS. Pinball-scope only. Ireland venues appear mixed into UK region listing (e.g. Base Arcade Belfast, Sportsland Portrush). Not a substitute for ZIv music-game coverage.

sources.name: NAMCO Funscape locations
sources.example_data_quote: Locations: Braintree, Metrocentre (Gateshead), Norwich, Romford, Tamworth, Trafford Centre. Braintree: Braintree Leisure Park, Charter Way, Braintree, CM77 8YH; hours Mon-Sun 10:00-23:00. Arcade activity page mentions 'dancing machines' generically with no per-site cab list.
sources.adds_over_current: Confirms 6 live Funscape sites and addresses/hours. Map already has Funscape entries from ZIv (e.g. Braintree ddr+other; Gateshead other-only with redemption/Mario Kart cabs only). Official site does NOT list per-venue music games, so it does not fix other-only Funscape rows.
sources.note: Bandai Namco Amusement Europe chain locator. Marketing site, not a machine database.

sources.name: Continue Arcades
sources.example_data_quote: Locations: Plymouth, Taunton, Swansea, Chichester, Tenby, Derby, Hemel. Site copy: free-play arcade, pay once play unlimited; pinball/racers/shooters mentioned. No structured per-venue machine inventory on the pages checked.
sources.adds_over_current: Chain has expanded (Hemel etc.). Map has several Continue? Arcades from ZIv with mixed coverage (Swansea ddr+other; Plymouth other+stepmaniax; Taunton other-only empty notes). Official site adds location discovery but not music-game classification.
sources.note: Growing free-play franchise. Per-city pages exist; machine lists not published systematically.

sources.name: High Score Arcades
sources.example_data_quote: Locations listed: Andover, Bracknell, Farnborough, Newport (Wales), Southampton, Swindon, Worcester (plus other pages reference Newbury). Free-play amusement centres; booking via Roller. No public per-site cab catalogue found on the site.
sources.adds_over_current: Operator locator for a multi-site free-play chain already partly in the map from ZIv (e.g. High Score Southampton has ddr+other with long cab notes including Dancing Stage SuperNOVA and DANCERUSH STARDOM). Does not add new classified music games beyond ZIv.
sources.note: Useful chain inventory for venue presence; marketing pages only for machines.

sources.name: NQ64 Arcade Bars
sources.example_data_quote: Chain of retro arcade bars (Soho, Shoreditch, Manchester NQ, Birmingham, Bristol, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Leeds, Nottingham, etc.). Per-location games pages claim counts like '31 arcade machines, 2 pinball, 8 retro consoles' at Soho. Full page content often behind bot protection when fetched headlessly.
sources.adds_over_current: Map already has multiple NQ64 rows from ZIv, typically ddr+other with retro cab notes (Dancing Stage EuroMIX, Guitar Hero Arcade, etc.), not modern e-amusement lineups. Official games pages may refresh retro lists but are not a bemani database and are hard to scrape reliably.
sources.note: Live chain site. Game lists appear per location when accessible; bot/Cloudflare friction for automated scrape.

sources.name: AURCADE location database
sources.example_data_quote: Arcade Club (Bury): Ela Mill, Cork Street BL9 7BW; 'Games: 216 Unique Games: 12'; description notes list incomplete and may cover inventory across three locations. Search UI requires filters; UK coverage sparse vs US.
sources.adds_over_current: Classic/video game tracking oriented. UK sample (Arcade Club) is incomplete relative to both ZIv notes and Arcade Club's own library. Not a maintained UK rhythm-game atlas.
sources.note: Global community DB. Thin UK density. Keep as secondary cross-check only.

sources.name: Leisureplex Ireland
sources.example_data_quote: Sites referenced: Blanchardstown, Charlestown, Coolock, Tallaght. Pool/arcade marketing page; no named rhythm cabinets or machine inventory. Instagram: bowling/arcade chain Ireland.
sources.adds_over_current: Map already has Leisureplex/Leisure Plex rows from ZIv with stepmaniax and/or pump_it_up on some sites and other-only on Coolock. Official site does not list cabs so cannot fill missing music-game classifications.
sources.note: Main Ireland multi-site leisure operator with arcades. Locator only.

summary:
Searched English-language web for UK/Ireland arcade and music-game venue databases (wiki, map, spreadsheet, forum lists, operator locators), plus operator brands (Arcade Club, NAMCO Funscape, Continue, High Score, NQ64, Leisureplex) and community trackers (Pinball Map, AURCADE, arcadelocations.net, StepManiaX locations, UKVAC, arcade-preservation fandom). Compared sample venues against data/arcades.json (747 UK+IE venues, 428 other-only; almost all src=ziv).

Finding: there is NO nationwide UK/IE equivalent of hkarcade.fandom.com for per-venue music/rhythm cabinets. ZIv is already the primary structured source for this region; many 'other-only' rows truly lack music games (redemption/family/bowling) rather than missing a secondary wiki. Best non-ZIv structured find is Arcade Club's official game library (3 venues, per-game venue tags including jubeat/pop'n/MÚSECA). Pinball Map UK (~228 venues) is excellent for pinball only. Chain locators (Funscape 6, Continue 7, High Score ~9, NQ64 ~12, Leisureplex IE 4) confirm addresses but rarely publish cab lists. Ireland has 28 map venues with no dedicated local music-arcade wiki found.
dead_ends: ZIv already in pipeline (excluded as a 'find'). StepManiaX official locations page (stepmaniax.com/locations/) responds but returned essentially empty HTML (app/JS map); existence of SMX in UK/IE is known via ZIv/app, not verified as a scrapable multi-venue DB here. freeplaycity.com returned 403; FreePlayCity London already richly filled in arcades.json from ZIv. arcadelocations.net UK list live but mostly 2000-2015 classic-only sightings, not useful for current music games. arcadepreservation.fandom.com UK category hit bot wall (unverified content). UKVAC is a collectors forum, not a venue machine DB. NQ64 per-location games pages often bot-gated. Pinball Map API requires token (RSS works without). No public maintained UK bemani/DDR spreadsheet or wiki found; UK DDR Discord/Facebook chatter exists but is not a structured multi-venue database. Google Maps/Yelp/TripAdvisor used only as references, not sources.
